en.headline: Police appeal for information on 80-year-old man missing in Tai Po
en.dek: Tung Chung-yin was last seen at Wu Kau Tang in Plover Cove Country Park on Sunday, and his family reported him missing on Tuesday.
body: Police have appealed for public information on an 80-year-old man who went missing in Tai Po after last being seen at Wu Kau Tang in Plover Cove Country Park on October 25.

According to a police statement issued on Wednesday, Tung Chung-yin’s family made a report on October 27. He is about 1.7 metres tall, weighs about 75 kilograms and is of medium build, with a round face, yellow complexion and short grey hair. He was last seen wearing a light blue short-sleeved shirt, dark pants and green camouflage shoes.

Anyone with information on his whereabouts is urged to contact the Regional Missing Persons Unit of New Territories North on 3661 3112 or any police station. A search has been under way since Tuesday night.

zh.headline: 警方呼籲提供大埔失踪80歲男子消息
zh.dek: 董中賢上星期日最後於大埔船灣郊野公園烏蛟騰出現，家人周二報案。
body: 警方今日呼籲市民提供有關一名大埔失踪80歲男子的消息。該男子上月25日最後於大埔船灣郊野公園烏蛟騰出現後失去聯絡。
警方表示，董中賢的家人昨日向警方報案。他身高約1.7米，體重約75公斤，中等身材，圓臉黃膚色，短灰髮。最後身穿淺藍色短袖衫、深色長褲及綠色迷彩鞋。
任何人士如知悉其下落，可致電3661 3112聯絡新界北區失踪人口調查組，或到就近警署協助。搜救行動自周二晚上展開。
